description: Kits that need host-app packages (from each kit’s docs/_playground.overrides.json → externalDependencies). Agents must NOT install packages — tell the user if they are missing.

map.note: Map wraps MapLibre. The host app must already have maplibre-gl (and any required CSS) installed. Agents must not install packages — tell the user if they are missing.

pb_bar_graph.note: This kit wraps Highcharts and does not ship it. The host app must already have these packages installed before using the kit. Agents must not install packages — tell the user if they are missing.

pb_circle_chart.note: This kit wraps Highcharts and does not ship it. The host app must already have these packages installed before using the kit. Agents must not install packages — tell the user if they are missing.

pb_gauge_chart.note: This kit wraps Highcharts and does not ship it. The host app must already have these packages installed before using the kit. Agents must not install packages — tell the user if they are missing.

pb_line_graph.note: This kit wraps Highcharts and does not ship it. The host app must already have these packages installed before using the kit. Agents must not install packages — tell the user if they are missing.

rich_text_editor.note: Default React editor uses Trix (pass TrixEditor from react-trix). Advanced React editor uses TipTap, and the host app must already have the needed packages installed. Agents must not install packages — tell the user if they are missing. Rails bundles TipTap in playbook-rails.js (no host packages needed) and accepts only these extension strings: underline, text_align, horizontal_rule, image.
